No floor, cast shadow, backdrop, lettering, watermark, glow cloud or surrounding border.

Make the WHOLE object only 65% of the square canvas height and width maximum, centered. All visible pixels, including every piece of cord or chain, must be comfortably inside the canvas. True transparent PNG alpha; do NOT draw any checkerboard, gray surface, paper, texture or background. One entire necklace only, with complete cord or chain and pendant, no wearer. Favor bold simple 64x64 pixel clusters.
